title: The Rise of AI-Generated Commercials: What It Means for 2026

facts.fact: Share of organizations using AI video in digital marketing rose from 51% in 2025 to 62% in 2026, per the page's chart (source not named), a change of 11 percentage points year over year.
facts.quote: Change:** up 11 percentage points year over year.

facts.fact: Advertising executives cited cost efficiency as a benefit of AI in advertising, the top-cited benefit in the 2026 study the page references.
facts.quote: Advertising executives cited cost efficiency as a benefit of AI in advertising (the top-cited benefit in the 2026 study).

facts.fact: CPG marketing leaders expected generative AI to help them work faster or more efficiently.
facts.quote: CPG marketing leaders expected generative AI to help them work faster or more efficiently.

facts.fact: Advertising executives cited creative innovation as a benefit of AI in advertising.
facts.quote: Advertising executives cited creative innovation as a benefit of AI in advertising.

facts.fact: Small and mid-size digital-video buyers were not satisfied with their current level of GenAI use for creative ad production.
facts.quote: Small and mid-size digital-video buyers were not satisfied with their current level of GenAI use for creative ad production.

facts.fact: 42% of surveyed advertising executives had deployed AI creative in audio advertising.
facts.quote: 42% of surveyed advertising executives had deployed AI creative in audio advertising.

facts.fact: 56% of surveyed advertising executives had deployed AI creative in television advertising.
facts.quote: 56% of surveyed advertising executives had deployed AI creative in television advertising.

facts.fact: 73% of surveyed advertising executives had deployed AI creative in display advertising.
facts.quote: 73% of surveyed advertising executives had deployed AI creative in display advertising.

facts.fact: 85% of AI-using advertisers had deployed AI creative in social media advertising.
facts.quote: 85% of AI-using advertisers had deployed AI creative in social media advertising.

facts.fact: In Adobe's 2026 report, 76% of organizations said generative AI moderately or significantly improved the volume and speed of content ideation and production.
facts.quote: 76% of organizations said generative AI moderately or significantly improved the volume and speed of content ideation and production.

facts.fact: In Adobe's 2026 report, 70% said generative AI improved content creation among non-creative teams.
facts.quote: 70% said generative AI improved content creation among non-creative teams.
